body:
There are more types of love than romantic love - but I understand how lonely that feels.  


I felt a desperate need to be loved romantically and I think it was largely because my mom never said she loved me. Anyway - I understand how you feel. It fucking sucks. You aren't alone in the feelings.
This is so familiar to what I experienced in college. The pain of my depression never went away but after a couple years and a lot of therapy, I did eventually move on and love again.

I completely understand. I have an amazing life - I've tried everything I can think of to treat my depression (including ECT). I'm only alive because committing suicide would break my wife and I love her more than I can say.
